description: Resting orders on the user's exchange accounts, including protective stop-loss and take-profit orders (is_trigger = true), and trigger entries TradeHub holds (type TRIGGER_ENTRY, order_id req_…). Use to find an order_id to cancel or to confirm a stop is in place. Not for filled trades (use get_my_trade_history). Inputs: optional venue and symbol filters. Sizes in the base coin, prices in USD. Next: cancel_order(order_id).
name: get_my_open_orders

deprecation.description: Present only while this tool is deprecated: replacement, removal_date, changelog

expires_at.description: TRIGGER_ENTRY: when it lapses unless reached, ISO 8601 UTC

oco_group.description: Such an entry's one-cancels-other group; once one entry of the group opens, the others are withdrawn

order_id.description: Venue order id; Binance stops look like algo:<id>

reduce_only.description: True if it can only reduce a position

request_id.description: An entry TradeHub placed that has not filled (a limit order or a TRIGGER_ENTRY): its order request, the id oco_with takes

size_base.description: Order size, in the base coin (e.g. BTC), not USD

stop_loss.description: TRIGGER_ENTRY: the stop it opens with, USD per coin

type.description: Order type as the venue reports it

deprecation.description: Present only while this tool is deprecated: replacement, removal_date, changelog

title: My open orders
